description: This script automates database operations for the OpenMRS project, including dropping and creating databases, and applying Liquibase snapshots to set up schema and data. It is used for testing and development purposes.

methods.name: drop_and_create_database
methods.description: Drops the existing OpenMRS database and creates a new, empty one using specified SQL scripts.

methods.name: update_database
methods.description: Runs Maven commands to update the database schema and data using Liquibase with specified snapshot files.

methods.name: echo_usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script when required arguments are not provided.
